# Tests/GameLogicTests/KnownPictures.txt
#
# The twins' pictures (D33). Beside each of the twins' known answers (KnownAnswers.txt), the picture digest of the same
# state: Elite::PictureDigest, the SHA-256 of what the player sees, the CGA's 16 KiB of video memory and then its 20
# register bytes (mode control, colour select and the 18 CRTC registers), the last two parts of the state digest. They
# were recorded from the native code in a run whose every state digest met the original's, so each is the original's.
#
# Format: one picture per line, three fields separated by single spaces, as in KnownAnswers.txt:
#
#   TWIN ORDINAL PICTURE
#
#   TWIN     the name the twin is made with, TwinRig rig("TwinTitle")
#   ORDINAL  the ordinal of the known answer the picture stands beside, which is the same state
#   PICTURE  Elite::PictureDigest, in lowercase hex
#
# Lines are sorted by twin and ordinal. Blank lines and lines that start with '#' are ignored.
#
# Checking: a TwinRig checks each picture as it checks the known answer beside it, and reports rather than fails: a picture
# that differs is written to the test's log with the twin, the ordinal and both values, and each twin logs how many
# pictures it checked and how many differ. A missing picture fails the twin, naming it and the ordinal.
#
# Recording: with OUTPOST_ELITE_RECORD_GUARD set, in one process and never in CI, each twin records its pictures instead,
# replacing its own lines, and only if every state digest it gave met its known answer. A second recording reproduces
# this file byte for byte. A twin that is deleted takes its lines with it.
#
